introduction: Greater Bakersfield Legal Assistance provides free civil legal services for low-income and elderly people in Kern County. Contact intake to ask whether it can help with your particular matter.

who: GBLA serves low-income and elderly Kern County residents. The organization must assess your case and service eligibility; a request does not guarantee representation.
sections.get: Its service areas include housing matters and public benefits. The housing work includes a Landlord-Tenant Assistance Center in the metropolitan Bakersfield courthouse.
sections.docs: Have notices, court documents and the names of the parties ready. State any hearing or response deadline immediately. Ask intake what financial evidence is needed before sending sensitive records.
sections.apply: Call 661-325-5943 and request intake information. Review GBLA’s services to identify the relevant unit.
sections.after: Clarify whether you are receiving advice, document assistance or representation. Keep tracking deadlines until someone explicitly accepts responsibility for a filing. Ask for another referral if your matter cannot be accepted.

faqs: Its published mission covers civil legal services; ask for an appropriate referral for other matters.
Can it help with a benefit denial?
GBLA lists Social Security and public benefit-related assistance; ask intake about your notice.

What if I have an eviction hearing soon?
Tell intake the date immediately and continue following court instructions.
